format: NeMo indicconformer-pa-v3-kirtan.nemo (fp32 PyTorch, torch.load weights_only=True), nemo 1.23.0rc0 config
front_end: NeMo AudioToMelSpectrogramPreprocessor from the checkpoint config ({'features': 80, 'n_fft': 512, 'window_size': 0.025, 'window_stride': 0.01, 'normalize': 'per_feature'}, defaults preemph 0.97, log add 2^-24, eval: no dither)
decoder: greedy CTC over the pa slice [3840,4096) + blank 5632 of the shared CTC head (= AI4Bharat multisoftmax language mask), pa sentencepiece decode
